origin_trial_advertised.description: FR-017: page carries ANY origin-trial token (not necessarily WebMCP). Informational only.

origin_trial_features.description: FR-017: decoded `feature` names from the token(s). Disambiguates third-party trials (reCAPTCHA/analytics) from WebMCP.

origin_trial_webmcp.description: FR-017: true only when a decoded feature identifies WebMCP — the Experiment-B-relevant signal.

page_language.description: BCP-47 tag from <html lang> or the Content-Language header (e.g. 'en', 'nl-be'). Feeds FR-003 so drafted descriptions are written in the site's primary language. Null when undeterminable.

iframes.description: FR-018: frames encountered below the top document.

cross_origin.description: True if the frame's origin differs from the crawled origin — the site owner cannot instrument it.

frame_url.description: FR-018: URL of the frame the element was found in (equals page_url for the top document).

owner_instrumentable.description: FR-018: false when the candidate lives in a cross-origin frame the site owner cannot instrument. Such candidates must never be approved for generation.
